title: Growing Sweet Corn from Seed to Harvest
reason: Demonstrates the process of growing corn from seed to harvest, covering pollination strategies, soil preparation, and harvesting techniques.

tasks.task: Explain the process of growing corn, including variety selection and timing.

subtasks.text: Discuss the types of corn available and recommend sweet corn for home gardens.
Describe the different ear development stages and potential issues to look out for.

tasks.task: Provide instructions for planting and spacing corn.

subtasks.text: Explain the importance of isolation to avoid cross-pollination and provide isolation block recommendations.
Discuss the spacing requirements and tassel formation for optimal pollination.

tasks.task: Share advice on soil preparation and fertilization for corn.

subtasks.text: Outline the process of amending soil and why it is necessary.
Describe the application of nitrogen-rich fertilizers for corn cultivation.

tasks.task: Offer tips on caring for and protecting corn plants.

subtasks.text: Explain the reason for avoiding mulch at the beginning of the corn plant's growth.
Describe the procedure for mulching corn and the benefits of doing so.

tasks.task: Guide the viewer through harvesting and preparing corn for consumption.

subtasks.text: Explain how to determine when corn is ready for harvest.
Demonstrate the ease of harvesting corn and preparing it for consumption via the 90s cooking method.
